title: How the repository becomes a release
summary: The root files, plugin manifest, automation, tests and release documents that support ADP.
body: This is the operational side of the repository: how contributors enter, how checks run, what the plugin loads and how a release is packaged. These are concise file-purpose overviews. A configured check is not evidence that it ran, and an old checklist is not the current release state.

cards.title: Keep evidence attached
cards.text: Name the commit and the exact checks that ran. Separate fixture results from deployed-host observations.

cards.title: Read historical numbers as history
cards.text: The draft release notes and checklist include old counts and claims. Verify the current tree, CI results and published checksum before a release.
